title: Add the focusreset event
body: Fire a bubbling, composed, cancelable `focusreset` event (using `FocusResetEvent`) when focus is involuntarily reset to a `Document`'s viewport because the focused area was removed from the DOM (`#node-remove-focus-fixup`) or stopped being a focusable area (`#focus-fixup-rule`, e.g. `disabled`, `hidden`, `inert`, `display: none`), and focus has not since been moved to another focusable area. - **Target**: Dispatched at the element itself if still connected, or at the nearest surviving connected ancestor (`Element`, `ShadowRoot`, or `Document`) when the focused node (or an ancestor) was removed. If a surviving ancestor is later removed before rendering, `pending focusreset target` walks up to the new surviving ancestor and retargets `pending focusreset related target`. - **`FocusResetEvent.relatedTarget`**: Exposes the `Element` that lost focus, retargeted against `currentTarget` (with disconnected shadow-tree candidates falling back to retargeting the shadow host when `currentTarget` is outside the shadow root). - **Timing**: Dispatched in `update the rendering` immediately after `#focus-fixup-rule`, coalescing multiple focus resets within the same frame and only firing if the document still has focus and no ongoing `navigate` event is handling focus reset automatically. Fixes #12842. - [ ] At least two implementers are interested (and none opposed): * Chromium * … - [x] [Tests](https://github.com/web-platform-tests/wpt) are written and can be reviewed and commented upon at: * https://github.com/web-platform-tests/wpt/pull/63595 - [x] [Implementation bugs](https://github.com/whatwg/meta/blob/main/MAINTAINERS.md#handling-pull-requests) are filed: * Chromium: https://issues.chromium.org/issues/572677865 * Gecko: https://bugzilla.mozilla.org/show_bug.cgi?id=2081188 * WebKit: https://bugs.webkit.org/show_bug.cgi?id=327387 - [x] [MDN issue](https://github.com/whatwg/meta/blob/main/MAINTAINERS.md#handling-pull-requests) is filed: https://github.com/mdn/mdn/issues/876 - [x] The top of this comment includes a [clear commit message](https://github.com/whatwg/meta/blob/main/COMMITTING.md) to use.
